title: FastAPI in Production
prereqs: A running kind cluster for the deploy challenge
description: Ship FastAPI like a senior: async & ASGI, Pydantic v2 models & validation, dependency injection, async SQLAlchemy, OAuth2 + JWT auth, background tasks, testing with httpx/pytest-asyncio, auto OpenAPI docs, uvicorn/gunicorn tuning, and Dockerizing + deploying to a kind cluster.
